description: One product, place, person or listing in a card: photo, badge, title, rating, price and up to three actions.

howToUse: Fill only what the item has: every field except `title` is optional and the card closes the gaps.
The first action is the main one; keep at most three.
`layout="horizontal"` puts the photo on the left for lists; on screens under 420px it stacks again.
Without `image` the card becomes compact: `category` and `badge` share the first line, as in a chat answer or a search result.
alternatives: A property listing with real estate fields: PropertyCard.
A link to an outside page: LinkCard.

import { EntityCard } from '@refy-design/web';
import type { ComponentProps } from 'react';
const photos = {
  homeQuiet: 'https://refy.design/demo/ape-silencioso.webp',
  shopTeapot: 'https://refy.design/demo/loja-bule.webp',
  personClara: 'https://refy.design/demo/pessoa-clara.webp',
};
export function Example() {
  const args: Pick<
    ComponentProps<typeof EntityCard>,
    | 'title'
    | 'subtitle'
    | 'image'
    | 'imageAlt'
    | 'price'
    | 'meta'
    | 'badge'
    | 'badgeTone'
    | 'rating'
    | 'actions'
    | 'layout'
    | 'description'
  > = {
    title: 'Quiet two-bedroom',
    subtitle: 'Savassi, Belo Horizonte',
    image: photos.homeQuiet,
    imageAlt: 'Living room with large windows facing the trees',
    price: '$ 1,450 / month',
    meta: '2 bedrooms · 64 m²',
    badge: undefined,
    badgeTone: 'info',
    rating: undefined,
    actions: [{ label: 'Schedule a visit' }, { label: 'Save' }],
    layout: 'horizontal',
    description: 'Bright corner unit, two blocks from the park.',
  };
  return <EntityCard {...args} />;
}
